description: Opens a pull request against Meetful's source code: a unified diff for a fix request, either an existing one (feedback_id) or a new one described in text. Nothing is applied automatically; a person reviews and merges it.

body.description: What changed and why, and how you checked it.

diff.description: Unified diff against the source, with diff --git headers.

text.description: If there is no feedback_id: what is being fixed, as a person would report it.

title.description: One line, like a commit subject.

name: submit_fix
title: Submit a fix to Meetful
